definitions.explanation: The initial or early phase of a process, condition, or time period.

examples.japanese: {病気|びょうき}を{早期|そうき}に{発見|はっけん}する。
{早期|そうき}{退職|たいしょく}を{選|えら}んだ。
{問題|もんだい}の{早期|そうき}{解決|かいけつ}を{目指|めざ}す。
examples.english: We aim for an early resolution of the problem.

notes:
{早期|そうき} means "early stage" or "early period" — it refers to the beginning phase of a process, condition, or timeline. Almost always used as a modifier before another noun.

COMPOUNDS:
- {早期|そうき}{発見|はっけん}: early detection
- {早期|そうき}{治療|ちりょう}: early treatment
- {早期|そうき}{退職|たいしょく}: early retirement
- {早期|そうき}{解決|かいけつ}: early resolution
- {早期|そうき}{教育|きょういく}: early education

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {早期|そうき}に{発見|はっけん}する: to detect at an early stage
- {早期|そうき}の{段階|だんかい}で: at an early stage

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {初期|しょき}: initial stage (the very beginning; also used for "early" in diseases)
- {早急|さっきゅう}: urgent, prompt (emphasizes speed rather than timing)
